51561503.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full-length wild-type human NNMT (1 to 270 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) cells assessed as dissociation constant by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: ITC measurements were performed at 25 °C using a MicroCal PEAQ Instrument (Malvern Instruments). hNNMT was dialyzed in ITC buffer (50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl) supplemented with 1% DMSO overnight and diluted to 60 μM. The ITC instrument was used to prepare a solution of II559 or II802 at 600 μM. Binding constants were calculated by fitting the data using the ITC data analysis module in Origin 7.0.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Figure 4. Inhibition and selectivity of II559, II802, and II562. (A) IC50 curves at 9 Km concentrations of both SAM and substrate in the SAHH-coupled fluorescence assay. Ki was calculated using the equation Ki = IC50/(1 + [S]/Km). (B–D) Selectivity studies for II559 (B), II802 (C), and II562 (D) against PNMT, PRMT1, TβPRMT7, G9a, SETD7, NTMT1, and SAHH with each compound at four different concentrations (100, 33.3, 11.1, and 3.7 μM). (E) Binding affinity of II559 and II802 for NNMT was measured through ITC. All experiments were performed in duplicate (n = 2). Values were presented as mean ± standard deviation (SD).
original_paragraph.Figure 4E: N = 0.9 KD = 147 ± 24 nM ΔH = -2.56 kcal/mol ΔG = -9.32 kcal/mol -TΔS = -6.77 kcal/mol
original_paragraph.Figure 4F: N = 0.9 KD = 234 ± 51 nM ΔH = -2.59 kcal/mol ΔG = -9.05 kcal/mol -TΔS = -6.46 kcal/mol
